_comment: VARIETYSTRUCTUREPLAN Band 2 (D4/§5) — layers a Prosperity Shard onto the Abandoned Inferium Plot's chest. Inert without Mystical Agriculture: AddDropModifier resolves the id via Lookup.hasItem and adds nothing when absent. Gate-safe: the prosperity shard is the mod's other mineable base material, never a prosperity block/ore, a seed base or an infusion component.
